cohort: 113,342 women who gave birth between 2005-2014 at a single center
finding: Modifiable risk factors for major obstetric hemorrhage include multifetal pregnancy, induction of labor, cesarean section, and instrumental delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean section (OR 25.56; 95 % CI 12.88-50.75; p < 0.001) and instrumental delivery (OR 6.58; 95 % CI 2.36-18.3; p < 0.001) were identified as significant risk factors for major obstetric hemorrhage.
